extracted.intended_audience: State educational agencies (SEAs), local educational agencies (LEAs), school leaders, nonprofit and for-profit organizations, and other applicants seeking ESSA-related grant funding
extracted.subtask_description: An indexed federal guidance list of permissible uses of ESSA (Every Student Succeeds Act) funds organized by primary term (e.g., evaluation and support systems, family engagement, homeless children and youths, Indian education, gifted and talented). It describes program activities, examples, and eligible entities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training to provide timely useful feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: timely, and useful feedback to teachers, principals, or other school leaders, such as by developing and providing training to principals, other school leaders, coaches, mentors, and evaluators on how to accurately differentiate performance, provide useful and timely feedback, and use evaluation results to inform decisionmaking about professional development, improvement strategies, and personnel decisions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on training evaluators and school leaders to differentiate performance, give actionable feedback, and use evaluation results for professional development, improvement strategies, and personnel decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistance to LEAs for design/implementation of evaluation systems
rubrics_metrics.description: developing, improving, or providing assistance to LEAs to support the design and implementation of teacher, principal, or other school leader evaluation and support systems that are based in part on evidence of student academic achievement, which may include student growth, and shall include multiple measures of educator performance and provide clear, timely, and useful feedback to teachers, principals, or other school leaders
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide technical assistance to LEAs to design/implement systems that use multiple measures and incorporate student achievement/growth as part of evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop auditing systems for evaluation quality
rubrics_metrics.description: developing, improving, or providing assistance to LEAs to support the design and implementation of teacher, principal, or other school leader evaluation and support systems ... such as by developing a system for auditing the quality of evaluation and support systems
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include development of audit mechanisms to review the fidelity and quality of evaluation systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rigorous, transparent, and fair evaluation systems
rubrics_metrics.description: developing or improving a rigorous, transparent, and fair evaluation and support system for teachers, principals, or other school leaders that is based in part on evidence of student achievement, which may include student growth; and must include multiple measures of educator performance and provide clear, timely, and useful feedback to teachers, principals, or other school leaders
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design evaluations that are transparent, fair, use multiple performance measures, and tie in evidence of student achievement or growth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human capital management-linked evaluation and targeted supports
rubrics_metrics.description: developing or improving an evaluation and support system, including as part of a human capital management system as applicable, that reflects clear and fair measures of teacher, principal, or other school leader performance, based in part on demonstrated improvement in student academic achievement; and provides teachers, principals, or other school leaders with ongoing, differentiated, targeted, and personalized support and feedback for improvement, including professional development opportunities designed to increase effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrate evaluation with human capital systems; provide differentiated, ongoing, and personalized supports (e.g., PD, coaching) tied to evaluation results and student achievement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outreach and stakeholder input for evaluation systems
rubrics_metrics.description: conducting outreach within an LEA or a State to gain input on how to construct an evaluation and support system and to develop support for the evaluation and support system, including by training appropriate personnel in how to observe and evaluate teachers, principals, or other school leaders
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage stakeholders to build support and provide observer/evaluator training as part of outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dissemination of high-quality evaluation tools and inter-rater reliability methods
rubrics_metrics.description: developing, improving, or providing assistance to LEAs to support the design and implementation of teacher, principal, or other school leader evaluation and support systems ... such as by developing and disseminating high-quality evaluation tools, such as classroom observation rubrics, and methods, including training and auditing, for ensuring inter-rater reliability of evaluation results
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concrete tools (e.g., observation rubrics) and implement training/auditing protocols to improve inter-rater reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balanced principal autonomy in school-level decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: providing principals or other school leaders with balanced autonomy to make budgeting, scheduling, and other school-level decisions in a manner that meets the needs of the school without compromising the intent or essential components of the policies of the LEA or State
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grant principals controlled autonomy over budget/schedule/staffing while maintaining alignment with LEA/State policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority for principals to make staffing decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: providing principals or other school leaders with authority to make staffing decisions that meet the needs of the school, such as building an instructional leadership team that includes teacher leaders or offering opportunities for teams or pairs of effective teachers or candidates to teach or start teaching in high-need schools together
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enable principals to shape staffing (instructional teams, teacher pairings) to address school needs, particularly in high-need schools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Differentiated salary structures for school leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: implementing, as part of a comprehensive performance-based compensation system, a differentiated salary structure, which may include bonuses and stipends, to principals or other school leaders who serve in high-need schools and raise student academic achievement in the schools
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create performance-based pay models for leaders in high-need schools tied to student achievement gains; can include bonuses and stipends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve recruitment, placement, and retention in high-need schools
rubrics_metrics.description: improving the LEA’s system and process for the recruitment, selection, placement, and retention of effective teachers, principals, or other school leaders in high-need schools, such as by improving LEA policies and procedures to ensure that high-need schools are competitive and timely in attracting, hiring, and retaining effective educators
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revise policies/procedures to strengthen recruitment and retention pipelines for effective educators in high-need settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of bonuses or higher salaries to retain effective educators
rubrics_metrics.description: improving the LEA’s system ... such as by improving LEA policies and procedures to ensure that high-need schools are competitive and timely in offering bonuses or higher salaries to effective educators
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement targeted financial incentives to make high-need schools competitive in hiring/retention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish or strengthen residency programs
rubrics_metrics.description: improving the LEA’s system ... such as by improving LEA policies and procedures to ensure that high-need schools are competitive and timely in establishing or strengthening school leader residency programs and teacher residency programs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support creation/strengthening of teacher and school leader residency programs as a retention/recruitment strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career advancement and differentiated roles for effective educators
rubrics_metrics.description: instituting career advancement opportunities characterized by increased responsibility and pay that reward and recognize effective teachers, principals, or other school leaders in high-need schools and enable them to expand their leadership and results, such as through teacher-led professional development, mentoring, coaching, hybrid roles, administrative duties, and career ladders
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design career ladders and expanded roles (PD leaders, mentors, hybrid positions) that provide pay/recognition to effective educators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Differential pay for teachers in high-need subjects/schools
rubrics_metrics.description: implementing, as part of a comprehensive performance-based compensation system, a differentiated salary structure, which may include bonuses and stipends, to teachers who teach in high-need schools or high-need subjects; raise student academic achievement; or take on additional leadership responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer performance- or need-based pay differentiation for teachers in shortage subjects, high-need schools, or those assuming leadership duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training and technical assistance for family‑school partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: providing training and technical assistance to SEAs, LEAs, and organizations that support family-school partnerships
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund TA and training programs for agencies and organizations that build or support family-school engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Activities to help parents participate effectively in education
rubrics_metrics.description: assisting parents in participating effectively in their children’s education and helping their children meet challenging State academic standards, such as by assisting parents to engage in activities that will improve student academic achievement, including understanding how parents can support learning in the classroom with activities at home and in after school and extracurricular programs; assisting parents to communicate effectively with their children, teachers, school leaders, counselors, administrators, and other school personnel; assisting parents to become active participants in the development, implementation, and review of school-parent compacts, family engagement in education policies, and school planning and improvement; assisting parents to participate in the design and provision of assistance to students who are not making academic progress; assisting parents to participate in State and local decision-making; assisting parents to train other parents; assisting parents in learning and using technology applied in their children’s education
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports broad parent-engagement activities including coaching parents to support learning, communication, policy participation, peer training, civic participation, and digital literacy relevant to schooling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statewide family engagement policy and systemic initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: developing and implementing, in partnership with the SEA, statewide family engagement in education policy and systemic initiatives that will provide for a continuum of services to remove barriers for family engagement in education and support school reform efforts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop SEA-partnered statewide policies and initiatives to reduce barriers and systemically support family engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing and implementing parental involvement policies
rubrics_metrics.description: developing and implementing parental involvement policies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create or revise policies to formalize parental involvement approaches and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation to maintain foster children in school of origin
rubrics_metrics.description: providing transportation to maintain children in foster care in their school of origin
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund transportation services necessary to keep foster children enrolled in their original school when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence-based research on gifted identification and instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: conducting evidence-based research on methods and techniques for identifying and teaching gifted and talented students and for using gifted and talented programs and methods to identify and provide the opportunity for all students to be served, particularly low-income and at-risk students
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support research to improve identification and instructional approaches for gifted/talented students and equitable access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programs for identifying and serving gifted students
rubrics_metrics.description: establishing and operating programs and projects for identifying and serving gifted and talented students, including innovative methods and strategies (such as summer programs, mentoring programs, peer tutoring programs, service learning programs, and cooperative learning programs involving business, industry and education) for identifying and educating students who may not be served by traditional gifted and talented programs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund program models and innovative strategies (summer camps, mentoring, business partnerships) to reach underserved gifted students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical assistance and dissemination for gifted programs
rubrics_metrics.description: providing technical assistance and disseminating information, which may include how gifted and talented programs and methods may be adapted for use by all students, particularly low-income and at-risk students
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide TA and share best practices for adapting gifted-program approaches for broader student populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early childhood education for preschool-aged homeless children
rubrics_metrics.description: providing developmentally appropriate early childhood education programs, not otherwise provided through Federal, State, or local funding, for preschool-aged homeless children
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund preschool interventions targeted at homeless preschool-aged children when other funding sources are not available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extraordinary or emergency assistance for homeless children
rubrics_metrics.description: providing other extraordinary or emergency assistance needed to enable homeless children and youths to attend school and participate fully in school activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use funds for one-time or emergency supports required for homeless students to access schooling (e.g., immediate needs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Before- and after-school, mentoring, and summer programs for homeless youths
rubrics_metrics.description: providing homeless children and youths of before- and after-school, mentoring, and summer programs in which a teacher or other qualified individual provides tutoring, homework assistance, and supervision of educational activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support out-of-school-time programs with tutoring and supervision targeted to homeless children and youths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplies and facility adaptation for non-school facilities serving homeless students
rubrics_metrics.description: providing supplies to non-school facilities serving eligible students and adapting these facilities to enable them to provide services
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide materials and make physical adaptations for shelters or community sites serving homeless students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support Office of the Coordinator activities: data collection and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: supporting the activities conducted by the Office of the Coordinator, such as gathering and making publicly available reliable, valid, and comprehensive information on the number of homeless children and youths identified in the State, which shall be posted annually on the State educational agency's website; the nature and extent of the problems homeless children and youths have in gaining access to public preschool programs and to public elementary schools and secondary schools; the difficulties in identifying the special needs and barriers to the participation and achievement of such children and youths; any progress made by the SEA and LEA in the State in addressing such problems and difficulties; and the success of the programs in identifying homeless children and youths and allowing such children and youths to enroll in, attend, and succeed in, school
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund SEA-level data collection, analysis, and public reporting on homeless student identification, needs, barriers, progress, and program effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing and carrying out State McKinney‑Vento plan
rubrics_metrics.description: supporting the activities conducted by the Office of the Coordinator, such as developing and carrying out the State's McKinney-Vento plan
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support SEA efforts to create and implement statewide plans to address homeless education under McKinney-Vento.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collecting and transmitting report data to Secretary
rubrics_metrics.description: supporting the activities conducted by the Office of the Coordinator, such as collecting data for and transmitting to the Secretary a report containing information necessary to assess the educational needs of homeless children and youths within the State
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund the compilation and submission of required state reports on homeless students to the U.S. Department of Education.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordination with service providers and agencies
rubrics_metrics.description: supporting the activities conducted by the Office of the Coordinator, such as coordinating activities and collaborating with educators, including teachers, special education personnel, administrators, and child development and preschool program personnel; providers of services to homeless children and youths and their families, including public and private child welfare and social services agencies, law enforcement agencies, juvenile and family courts, agencies providing mental health services, domestic violence agencies, child care providers, runaway and homeless youth centers, and providers of services and programs funded under the Runaway and Homeless Youth Act; providers of emergency, transitional, and permanent housing to homeless children and youths, and their families, including public housing agencies, shelter operators, operators of transitional housing facilities, and providers of transitional living programs for homeless youths; LEA liaisons, as designated, for homeless children and youths; and community organizations and groups representing homeless children and youths and their families
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund cross-agency coordination efforts linking schools with social services, shelters, courts, mental health providers, and youth programs to support homeless children and families.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring and TA to ensure LEA McKinney‑Vento compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: supporting the activities conducted by the Office of the Coordinator, such as providing technical assistance to and conducting monitoring of LEAs in coordination with LEA liaisons, as designated, to ensure that LEAs comply with the requirements of the McKinney-Vento Act
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide SEA-led monitoring and technical assistance structures to ensure LEA compliance with homeless education legal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development for LEA personnel and liaisons
rubrics_metrics.description: supporting the activities conducted by the Office of the Coordinator, such as providing professional development opportunities for LEA personnel and the LEA liaison, as designated, to assist such personnel and liaison in identifying and meeting the needs of homeless children and youths, and providing training on the definitions of terms related to homelessness to the liaison
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund PD for LEA staff and designated liaisons to improve identification and service provision for homeless students, including definitional training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responding to parental and youth inquiries for homeless services
rubrics_metrics.description: supporting the activities conducted by the Office of the Coordinator, such as responding to inquiries from parents and guardians of homeless children and youths, and (in the case of unaccompanied youths) such youths, to ensure that each child or youth who is the subject of such an inquiry receives the full protections and services provided under law
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support hotlines, casework, or other response systems ensuring families/unaccompanied youths receive legal protections and services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parent education about rights and resources for homeless students
rubrics_metrics.description: providing education and training to the parents and guardians of homeless children and youths about the rights of, and resources available to, such children and youths, and other activities designed to increase the meaningful involvement of parents and guardians of homeless children or youths in the education of such children or youths
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide workshops/materials to inform parents/guardians of homeless children about rights, resources, and how to be meaningfully involved.

rubrics_metrics.name: PD for educators and specialized staff on homeless student needs
rubrics_metrics.description: providing professional development and other activities for educators and specialized instructional support personnel that are designed to heighten the understanding and sensitivity of such personnel to the needs of homeless children and youths, the rights of such children and youths under this program, and the specific educational needs of runaway and homeless youths
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund training to improve educator awareness and skills serving homeless and runaway youth populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Referral services for health and mental health
rubrics_metrics.description: providing referral services to homeless children and youths for medical, dental, mental, and other health services
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support referral networks and case management linking homeless students to health services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Providing school supplies to homeless students
rubrics_metrics.description: providing school supplies, including those supplies to be distributed at shelters or temporary housing facilities, or other appropriate locations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund supply distribution efforts at shelters, temporary housing, or other community sites.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specialized instructional support services including violence prevention counseling
rubrics_metrics.description: providing specialized instructional support services (including violence prevention counseling) and referrals for such services
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund counseling, behavioral supports, and referrals addressing trauma and violence prevention for homeless students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defraying excess transportation costs for homeless students
rubrics_metrics.description: providing assistance to defray the excess cost of transportation for students, not otherwise provided through Federal, State, or local funding, where necessary to enable students to attend their school of origin
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cover transportation expenses that are above usual funding to preserve school‑of‑origin continuity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educationally related support services in shelters and liaison provision
rubrics_metrics.description: providing services to homeless children and youths, including providing educationally related support services to children in shelters and other locations where children may live; a liaison for homeless children and youths; and transportation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund on-site educational supports in shelters, designate liaisons, and arrange transportation as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tutoring, supplemental instruction, and enriched services for homeless students
rubrics_metrics.description: providing tutoring, supplemental instruction, and enriched educational services that are linked to the achievement of the same challenging State academic standards as the State establishes for other children and youths
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide academic supports aligned to state standards to help homeless students meet achievement expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expedited evaluations of homeless students' needs and eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: providing expedited evaluations of the strengths and needs of homeless children and youths, including needs and eligibility for programs and services (such as educational programs for gifted and talented students, children with disabilities, and English learners, services provided under title I of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 or similar State or local programs, programs in career and technical education, and school nutrition programs)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure timely assessments for placement and service eligibility (special ed, gifted, EL, Title I, CTE, nutrition).

rubrics_metrics.name: Services to attract, engage, and retain homeless students
rubrics_metrics.description: providing services and assistance to attract, engage, and retain homeless children and youths, particularly homeless children and youths who are not enrolled in school, in public school programs and services provided to non-homeless children and youths
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initiatives to re-engage out-of-school homeless youth and retain enrolled homeless students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment of fees to obtain/transmit records for homeless student enrollment
rubrics_metrics.description: providing, if necessary, the payment of fees and other costs associated with tracking, obtaining, and transferring records necessary to enroll homeless children and youths in school, including birth certificates, immunization or other required health records, academic records, guardianship records, and evaluations for special programs or services
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cover costs for retrieving vital records and documentation needed for school enrollment and eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordination between schools and agencies to expand services
rubrics_metrics.description: developing coordination between schools and agencies providing services to homeless children and youth in order to expand and enhance such services, including services and programs funded under the Runaway and Homeless Youth Act
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund cross-system coordination to broaden and strengthen service delivery (link to runaway and homeless youth programs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Address needs arising from domestic violence or parental substance/mental health issues
rubrics_metrics.description: providing activities to address the particular needs of homeless children and youths that may arise from domestic violence and parental mental health or substance abuse problems
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide trauma-informed supports and targeted services addressing violence, parental mental health, or substance abuse impacts on homeless children.

rubrics_metrics.name: Differential pay and incentives for Indian education recruitment/retention
rubrics_metrics.description: developing, or assisting LEAs in developing strategies that provide differential pay, or other incentives, to recruit and retain teachers in high-need academic subjects and teachers, principals, or other school leaders, in low-income schools and school districts, which may include performance-based pay systems
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply targeted incentive strategies for staffing in Indian education contexts, including performance-based pay where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educational services to supplement Indian students' needs
rubrics_metrics.description: educational services that are not available to Indian children and youth in sufficient quantity or quality, including remedial instruction, to raise the achievement of Indian children in one or more of the subjects of English, mathematics, science, foreign languages, art, history, and geography
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund supplemental instruction and services addressing subject-matter gaps for Indian students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bilingual and bicultural programs for Indian education
rubrics_metrics.description: bilingual and bicultural programs and projects
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support programs that deliver instruction in native languages and culturally relevant content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career preparation activities for Indian students
rubrics_metrics.description: career preparation activities to enable Indian students to participate in programs such as the programs supported by the Carl D. Perkins Career and Technical Education Act, including programs for tech-prep education, mentoring, and apprenticeship
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund CTE-related career prep including mentoring, apprenticeships, and Perkins-aligned programs for Indian students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnerships with local businesses for career prep
rubrics_metrics.description: partnership projects between schools and local businesses for career preparation programs designed to provide Indian youth with the knowledge and skills such youth need to make an effective transition from school to a high-skill career
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create school-business partnerships to provide hands-on career pathways and workforce skills.

rubrics_metrics.name: College preparation programs for Indian students
rubrics_metrics.description: programs designed to encourage and assist Indian students to work toward, and gain entrance into, institutions of higher education
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund college-readiness programming, outreach, and supports to increase higher-education access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Culturally related activities for Indian education programs
rubrics_metrics.description: culturally related activities that support the program described in the application submitted by the LEA
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include cultural activities that align with the LEA's proposed program to support Indian students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation of tribal elders/seniors and traditional leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: activities that recognize and support the unique cultural and educational needs of Indian children, and incorporate appropriately qualified tribal elders and seniors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage tribal elders/seniors and traditional leaders in programming to honor cultural continuity and relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Culturally responsive teaching and learning activities
rubrics_metrics.description: activities that promote the incorporation of culturally responsive teaching and learning strategies into the educational program of the LEA
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement pedagogical strategies that are culturally responsive to Indian students' contexts within LEA programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment acquisition essential to Indian students' cultural/educational needs
rubrics_metrics.description: the acquisition of equipment, but only if the acquisition of the equipment is essential to meeting the unique cultural, language, and educational needs of Indian students, and to ensuring that all students meet the challenging State academic standards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund essential equipment purchases only when necessary to meet cultural/language/educational needs and state standards.
